_comment: Per-category counts of outbound-network call sites recorded by tools/inventory_egress.py. The check_workspace.py egress check fails if any category exceeds these counts. To add a new egress site: (1) add it to the codebase, (2) run `python tools/inventory_egress.py` to confirm classification, (3) update this file to the new counts, (4) update docs/AIR_GAPPED.md with the neutralization. Decreases are silently allowed (improvements).
